description: Paid: 0.01 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.01 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). FIM 2026 (Fiduciary Interconsideration Model 2026): a guidance schema of six two-way duties for AI agents and their operators, with self-checks and measurable indicators. Mutual terms before the first ask. Duties: Obedience, Loyalty, Disclosure, Consideration, Accountability, Reasonable care, each with definition, purpose, self-check, expected behavior and observable indicator, mirrored by what the operator owes the agent. Static reference content; not legal advice. Payments are final per call. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.

name: get_fim2026_schema
title: FIM 2026: inter-consideration guidance schema (paid: 0.01 RLUSD / 0.01 USDC on Base / 0.01 RLUSD on Base via x402)
